messages:
John (Support): seeing a sudden spike in 502/504s for hosted inference since ~13:12 UTC. A lot of customers reporting timeouts. Gateway logs show 'downstream kv_auth error' and 'prefetch fallback -> 5xx'. Anyone picking this up?

Ash (Infra): I see repeated auth failures from gateway->memcached pool 10.2.4.*: 
```
ERROR gateway kv_client.go:241 auth failed: invalid token for pool pfx-live-1 from 10.2.4.5
WARN pool pfx-live-1: falling back and returning 502
```
Trying to pull memcached auth logs now.

Maria (Prod): FYI we rolled the token-rotator canary v2.1.0 at 13:09 UTC (10% traffic). Could be a rotated token not propagated. @deploy-bot posted the deploy.

deploy-bot: deployed service/token-rotator v2.1.0 -> canary(10%) at 2026-03-17T13:09:02Z.

Alex (Runtime): quick mitigation: disable prefix prefetch fallback to avoid synchronous KV hits until auth stabilized. Patch snippet (apply to runtime config):
```
FEATURE_PREFETCH_ENABLED=false
KV_FALLBACK_STRATEGY=local-cache
KV_TIMEOUT_MS=1500
```
That should reduce 5xx while we fix tokens.

Ash (Infra): confirmed memcached auth errors are 13:10:30 -> 13:14:00 across 3 pools. Example gateway request_id=abc12345: 
```
[13:11:02] req=abc12345 GET /v1/generate -> kv_auth: AUTH_FAILED pool=pfx-live-1
[13:11:02] req=abc12345 fallback->fail status=502
```

John (Support): repro steps I used for a customer: 
```
curl -i -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer <customer-token>' \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{"model":"redwood-1","input":"hi"}'
# returns 502 with body: {"error":"upstream kv failure: auth"}
```
Request IDs: abc12345, def67890, ghi24680 (attached tickets).

Ella (Billing): confirmed Dedicated customers on reserved capacity also seeing intermittent 502s but no billing impact; we're tracking open support tickets.

Maria (Prod): rolling token-rotator canary back to 0% now. If that clears auth mismatch we can then redeploy with longer propagation window.

deploy-bot: rollback token-rotator -> v2.1.0 canary -> 0% at 2026-03-17T13:16:40Z.

oncall-bot: incident INC-2026-121 created (hosted-inference kv auth spike -> 5xx)
Severity: P2.

Ash (Infra): after rollback I see auth error count dropping. Memcached pools show normal auth success rates by 13:18. Still monitoring.

Alex (Runtime): pushed temporary config change to disable prefetch on prod routers (non-disruptive). TTL for change = 60m.

John (Support): customers reporting recovery starting ~13:19 UTC, samples now 200/OK. I'll update tickets and mark affected partner list.

Ella (Billing): keeping customers updated; no quota or billing reconciles needed for now.

Maria (Prod): root cause postmortem note: token-rotator rollout had a propagation bug where some memcached auth tokens were invalid for a short window when canary traffic hit certain pools. Action items: add token propagation verification job + staggered rollout.

Ash (Infra): action: add short circuit on gateway to return 503 instead of 502 when dependency auth is failing to avoid consumer-side retries. Filed infra-#342.

John (Support): thanks all — closing thread once PMs confirm postmortem draft. :thumbsup:
